campos.descripcion: Created by BeagleBoard.org Foundation, BeagleBoard PocketBeagle 2 is an upgraded version of the popular BeagleBoard PocketBeagle, designed as an ultra-compact, low-cost, and powerful single-board computer (SBC). Powered by Texas Instruments AM6254 SoC, it delivers high performance, advanced security, extensive connectivity, and advanced capabilities for developers, students, and hobbyists and innovators.
